get.summary: Report that the server is up.
List saved projects, most recent first. Each entry is the project's latest version.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of projects to return (default 24, at most 100).

post.summary: Upload an image. Re-uploading identical bytes returns the existing record.

delete.summary: Delete an image, every version edited from it, and their stored files.

patch.summary: Rename a project: every version leading to this image takes the new name.

post.summary: Start detecting and outlining the objects in an image.
post.description:
The returned job streams one `object_found` event per object. Results are cached, so
analysing the same image again is instant.

post.summary: Apply a batch of edits to an image.
post.description:
Starts a job that summarises the edits, asks the image model for the result using the
preview as a geometry reference, and blends it into the original so only the edited areas
change. Follow it with the job's event stream, then fetch the result.

get.summary: The versions leading to an image, original first, each with what its edit changed.

200.description: Versions from the original to this image

get.summary: List the objects found in an image.

404.description: Unknown image, or it has not been analysed yet

get.summary: Download one object's mask as a grayscale PNG (white is the object).

post.summary: Suggest the properties that can be edited on an object.
post.description: Results are cached, so repeated calls are free. Calls a model on first use.

404.description: Unknown image or object, or not analysed yet

503.description: No API key, no credits, or the models are unreachable

post.summary: Place the on-canvas control for one property of an object.
post.description:
Results are cached. The geometry is validated and snapped onto the object's mask; if the
model cannot produce a usable plan, a sensible default placement is returned instead.

503.description: No API key, no credits, or the models are unreachable

delete.summary: Request cancellation of a job. Cancelling a finished job has no effect.

post.summary: Accept an edit: store its result as a new image that can be edited further.

201.description: The accepted result as a new image

get.summary:
Stream a job's events as server-sent events. Each event is a [`JobEvent`] JSON object;
the stream ends after the terminal event.
Download the image generated by a finished edit job (PNG).

delete.summary: Throw away the result of an edit that was not accepted.

put.summary: Choose the model for each AI stage. Any OpenRouter model id is accepted.
Save the OpenRouter API key. It is stored on the server and never returned.

400.description: That does not look like an API key

delete.summary: Remove the stored API key. A key set through the environment is unaffected.

Axis.description: A line segment along which a slider moves.

BBox.description: An axis-aligned box in normalised image coordinates.

ChangeSummary.description: One line of the change log for an applied edit.

text.description: Plain-language description, for example "Shortened the couch to about 60% of its length".

ContentHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of an image's bytes.

DetectedObject.description: An object found in an image.

outline.description: Simplified outline of the object's mask, as a closed polygon.

Edit.description: One user edit on one object property.

oneOf.description: A slider moved to `value`.

The line the handle moved along. Its start stays fixed, which lets the edit be
described in words ("keeping the left end in place").

value.description: New value, as a multiplier (`1.0` is unchanged).

oneOf.description: Points moved from `origin` to `target`.
Handles moved from `origin` to `target`.
The object turned about `pivot`.

degrees.description: Clockwise turn in degrees as seen in the photo; negative is anticlockwise.

pivot.description: The point the object turned about, so the edit can be put in words.

oneOf.description: The whole object resized evenly about `pivot`.

pivot.description: The anchor that stayed fixed, so the edit can be put in words.

value.description: New size as a multiplier (`1.0` is unchanged).

oneOf.description: The whole object moved, as a share of the image's width and height.

dx.description: Rightward shift as a fraction of the image width; negative is leftward.

dy.description: Downward shift as a fraction of the image height; negative is upward.

EditChange.description: The change a user made with a widget.

EditRequest.description: A request to apply a batch of edits to an image.

edits.description: The edits, applied together in one generation.

model.description: Image model to use instead of the configured generator.

preview_kind.description: What `preview_png` shows. Defaults to a warped render of the edited objects.

preview_png.description: Base64 PNG used as a geometry reference for the model; see `preview_kind`.

EditResult.description: The outcome of a successful edit job.

cost_usd.description: Cost of the image generation in US dollars, when reported.

generation_ms.description: How long the image generation took.

instruction.description: The instruction that was sent to the image model.

model.description: The image model that produced the result.

summary.description: One-line summary of everything that changed.

ErrorBody.description: JSON body of every error response.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error identifiers exposed through the API.

status.description: Always `ok` while the server is running.

oneOf.description: What produced this version from its parent; absent for an original upload.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the original bytes; identical uploads share one record.

name.description: Project name shared by every version of the same photo.

oneOf.description: The version this one was edited from; absent for an original upload.

size_bytes.description: Size of the original file in bytes.

JobCreated.description: Reference to a newly started background job.

job_id.description: Use with the `/jobs/{id}` routes to follow progress.

oneOf.description: A pipeline stage started or advanced.
A line of reasoning or diagnostics for the output panel.
An object was found during image analysis.
The job finished successfully.
The job failed.
The job was cancelled.

JobEvent.description: An event streamed to clients while a job runs.

oneOf.description: Failure code when `status` is `failed`.

finished_at.description: When the job reached a terminal state.

kind.description: What the job does, for example `analyze`.

KeyOrigin.description: Where the OpenRouter key comes from.

KeyStatus.description: Whether AI features can run, without revealing any secret.

configured.description: True when AI requests can be made.

ModelSettings.description:
Which model each AI stage uses. Any OpenRouter model id is allowed, including
`typesafe/jev-router`, which picks a model and reasoning effort per request.

draft_generator.description: A faster, cheaper generator offered as a draft option when retrying.

fallback.description: Tried when the stage's own model fails or is unavailable.

suggester.description: Suggests editable properties for an object.

summariser.description: Summarises edits into instructions and change logs.

ui_planner.description: Plans where a control sits on the canvas.

NormalizedPoint.description: A point in normalised image coordinates (origin top-left).

ObjectId.description: Index of a detected object within one image.

PlanWidget.description: Which property to place a control for.

property.description: A property key returned by the properties route.

PreviewKind.description: What the reference image sent with an edit shows.

Property.description: An editable property of an object.

PropertyList.description: The editable properties suggested for one object.

name.description: The new project name (1 to 80 printable characters).

SetKey.description: Body for saving an API key.

models.description: The model used by each AI stage.

UploadForm.description: Multipart form accepted by the upload endpoint.

file.description: The image file (JPEG, PNG or WebP).

oneOf.description: A slider scaling a property between `min` and `max`.
Control points forming a shape.
Independent handles.
A handle on a ring around `pivot`; dragging it around the ring turns the object.

handle.description:
Where the handle rests. Its distance from `pivot` is the ring's radius and its
direction is the zero angle.

pivot.description: The point the object turns about, which stays fixed.

oneOf.description: A handle that resizes the whole object evenly about a fixed anchor.

axis.description: `start` is the anchor that stays fixed; `end` is where the handle rests.

oneOf.description: A handle that moves the whole object without changing its shape.

handle.description: Where the handle rests, on the object.

Widget.description: Placement and geometry of a control on the canvas.

WidgetKind.description: The kind of on-canvas control used to edit a property.
